subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should authorized Feishu whole-message text slash commands beyond abort triggers, especially `/status` and `/new`, bypass the per-chat sequential queue during active runs and be marked as structured `text-slash` command turns after channel admission?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent fix changes the product and security boundary between Feishu sender admission, command authorization, and state-mutating session commands during active runs.

options.title: Adopt Feishu-Scoped Text Command Contract
options.body: Mark authorized Feishu whole-message slash commands as structured text command turns and route only explicitly immediate controls out of the ordinary same-chat lane, with `/new` semantics documented by tests.

options.title: Keep Abort-Only Bypass
options.body: Leave `/status` and `/new` on the ordinary Feishu lane and document that only abort text bypasses active per-chat queueing.

options.title: Move Policy Into Shared Channel Helpers
options.body: Centralize text-command turn construction and bypass decisions across channels, accepting a broader compatibility and security review surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt Feishu-Scoped Text Command Contract
recommendation.body: Mark authorized Feishu whole-message slash commands as structured text command turns and route only explicitly immediate controls out of the ordinary same-chat lane, with `/new` semantics documented by tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on shared command authorization and command-turn context where the feature-history evidence is strongest.
